name: Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares
desc:
An Abyssal creature that creeps through rifts in the hidden depths, quietly watching this world. Its eerie, faceless form is said to be nothing more than a projection, for its true body exists only as a formless mass of pure Abyssal energy.
Even invaders who seek to claim this world must obey its rules to some extent. Unless the heavens split open and the earth's defenses collapse, these star-born outsiders can do little more than linger at the world's fringes, whispering their madness into this realm, their attempts to seep inside amounting to nothing... But how long can this stability and order truly last?

value.text: Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares

customize.text: Lord of the swarm of monsters that surged through the Rift of Hidden Depths. Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares will deploy the Deepdark Shield in combat, summoning several Fishers of Hidden Depths. The shield(s) can only be broken by Elemental Attacks or reaction DMG. <color=#ffe14b>Lunar Reaction DMG</color> is especially effective at breaking the shield(s). Additionally, defeating a summoned Fisher of Hidden Depths will also deal damage to its shield.

<color=#ffd780>"We Call This Efficiency"</color>
Break its shield without defeating any Fishers of Hidden Depth summoned by the Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares

dropMaterial.name: Remnant of the Dreadwing
dropMaterial.desc:
A deep-black bone relic taken from the lingering corruption left behind after defeating the Whisperer of Nightmares that came invading from beyond this world.
The formless beast that soared through the starless void should never have required organs this world calls "wings." Those grotesque, profane appendages may have arisen to adapt to the laws beneath the moon, or perhaps they are merely the distorted fragment of its true form that mortal eyes are able to witness.
